title: Worker screens: auto mode refuses gh pr create with nobody to ask
notes: Seen on the --screen trial (card 95dd8b3b, PR #216): the worker's auto-mode check refused gh pr create as an external write and the turn ended with a Decision; a pane send saying the user approves let it carry on. A terminal worker under the same prompt was not run to compare. Find whether the terminal asks where the screen refuses, and give the screen the same path (a question in its box, or the user's allow rules).

comments.body: Shipped in #224: the trial's gh pr create refusal did not reproduce. A worker screen takes the terminal's permission path: the user's allow rules first, a question in its box for what auto mode cannot decide. settingSources is now explicit in chat-sessions.ts; workers-decision-5 updated.
